thread:
alex: We're seeing repeat postmortem actions slip. I sketched a short escalation + IC rotation template to try for a pilot.

priya: paste the template pls

alex: short template:

```
T+12h: assign primary + backup, add severity tag, set rollback-owner
T+48h: remediation scope (what, tests, rollback) + target ETA
T+7d: checkpoint (status, blockers, PR links)
T+21d: QA/regression + ops doc update
T+45d: closure review + metrics verification
Recurring: same fingerprint 2x in 60d -> auto-notify SRE lead + schedule 60m pattern review
IC rotation: 1 week IC w/ named backup; outgoing IC must scaffold followups before handoff
```

noah: add bot reminders (12h, 48h, 7d, 21d) and a tiny Console tile for overdue actions + CSV export.

incident-bot: I can scaffold: `/incident followup create --owner @alice --backup @noah --due 7d --tags remediation` and will DM reminders at scheduled checkpoints.

priya: I'll run a 5-week pilot with the current oncall cohort. metrics: %assigned<12h, median time-to-scope, overdue@21d. will post weekly status.

alex: thanks — I'll update the runbook and post the short checklist in #eng-oncall before pilot kickoff. :thumbsup:
